data.inverter_brand: Select the brand of inverter that you are using

data.inverter_integration: Select which of the installed integrations to use to control your inverter

tariff_source.title: Select Tariff Source
tariff_source.description: Specify how import and export tariffs will be configured.

octopus_account.title: Enter Octopus Account Details
octopus_account.description: Provide your Octopus Energy Account ID and API Key to retrieve tariff codes automatically.

tariff_codes.title: Enter Tariff Codes
tariff_codes.description: Manually enter your import and export tariff codes.

tariff_entities.title: Price Entities
tariff_entities.description: Choose the entities that provide your import and export prices. Entities with a list of rates (such as the Octopus Energy integration's current and next day rates) give Miser future prices; an entity with only a numeric state is used as a flat price. Prices are read on every optimiser run.

data_description.import_entities: Select today's and tomorrow's rate entities so Miser can see ahead.
data_description.export_entities: Leave empty if you are not paid for export.

system_parameters.title: Enter System Parameters
system_parameters.description: Provide the specifications for your energy system, such as battery capacity and power. These are initial values and can be edited via the Miser UI.
